metadata.datasource: Kodak publication F-4043 (February 2016), vector paths of p7 (spectral sensitivity; contrast index vs time) and p8 (D-76 small-tank characteristic curves, 6/8/11 min).

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 360-650 nm: the D = 0.3 above D-min curve (the upper one); ASSUMED held below 360 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0907 dex/nm above 650 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -1.80..2.03 (D-76 small tank, 20 C, to contrast index 0.56 (time read off the sheet's own D-76 contrast-index line): 7.4 min, interpolated between the plotted 6 and 8 min curves; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.634); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.567 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: SHEET ISO 400 + LIT: 0 = log10(0.8/400)+1.0 = -1.699 log lux-s
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0406 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
